product_flow.name: Dolls representing human beings, toys representing animals or non-human creatures

required_qualifiers: actual complete toy character and intended function
shell polymer and woven/knit pile construction
actual eye and nose material and fixing
actual included mechanisms or explicit absence
actual manufacturer specification and release tests
raw WIP and nonWIP stocks with inherited exchange vectors
original service Q_H and observed H
actual assets and repair parts with water states
actual gas sources and receiving media

product_flow.name: 人形玩偶，动物或非人形玩偶

required_qualifiers: 实际完整玩具形象及用途
外壳聚合物与机织或针织绒面结构
填充聚合物及纤维结构
制造商规格及放行检验
原料WIP和非WIP库存及继承交换向量
资产及维修件和水状态
